items.t: Why Is IREN Stock Surging on Friday?
items.sum: IREN Limited (NASDAQ: IREN) stock gained on Friday without company news as traders bought AI infrastructure stocks amid a broader U.S. technology rebound.

items.t: IREN stock price is down 80% over six months. Here’s why
items.sum: IREN’s (IREN) shares have plunged nearly 80% over six months as financing uncertainty, execution risks and declining GPU rental prices undermine investor confidence in the bitcoin miner’s AI cloud transition.

items.t: SpaceX Slashes GPU Pricing? Plus, IREN’s Selloff and CoreWeave’s Distressed Bonds
items.sum: Today, we open up with unconfirmed reports that SpaceX is dropping its GPU rental prices, IREN's stock price selloff, and CoreWeave's bond rout.

items.t: Will Funding Gap Change IREN Stock Narrative
items.sum: IREN is pushing ahead with multi gigawatt AI data center projects in Texas and Australia while facing a roughly US$6b funding gap on a nearly US$15b near term build plan, tighter GPU lending terms, and regulatory reviews that affect large power approvals. items.t: Prediction: IREN’s Microsoft Deal Could Be Just the Beginning of Its Next Growth Phase
items.sum: IREN has dropped its Bitcoin mining roots and now owns the land, power, and data centers beneath its AI chips, yet the stock keeps sinking. What would it take for the market to finally notice, and could the price double?

items.t: Anthropic Sinks 8%, Falls Further Below IPO Price Despite Cathie Wood Buying the Dip; IREN Tumbles 11%, CoreWeave Retreats 10%
items.sum: Cathie Wood has bought Anthropic every single day since the IPO, yet Jim Cramer says nobody large is on the other side. With inflation climbing and AI infrastructure names buckling, who is left to catch the fall?
